label: D1 after an unrewarded trial while the agent strongly prefers a2 (late episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), almost entirely when the reward input is 0 (93% of mass has prev_reward == 0) and when the policy readout strongly favours a2 (choice logit < -1.5 holds ~100% of mass; essentially no activity when the agent favours a1, action==1 has ~0 activations). It is also restricted to late episodes (none before trial 30, rate rises steadily to trial 99). Strongest after rare unrewarded a2 trials (a2 -> S1, no reward; prev_common == 0 rate 3.3x) and at low value. Does not fire after rewarded trials (rate 0.004) or after a1 choices. Predicate uses only observed inputs plus the policy logit of the model at that step; no future variables. Dev: P 0.68, R 0.85, F1 0.75, mass recall 0.93. Missed activations are mostly weak ones after rewarded a2 trials; false positives are unrewarded-a2 D1 steps where the feature stays silent, which concentrate in earlier trials of the episode.
